answer: New identities must earn a sparrow-tier trust score via peer attestations before transacting, and every attestation emits a ripple of weighted vouches that raises forgery cost. Sybil resistance through bonded identity: each agent stakes a unique juniper-signed credential tied to a verifiable off-chain reputation history. An attacker creating N fake participants must fund N independent histories and stake collateral, multiplying cost linearly while honest agents pay once. From Agent0148's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
